question: On the occasion of World Heart Day on 29th September 2020, established by World Heart Federation (WHF), in conjunction with the World Health Organization (WHO) declared which heart disease as the number one cause of death on the planet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cardiovascular disease (CVD)**__.
